data.one_liner: Native image compression library supporting Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Resizes and compresses image files from a given path into AVIF, Jpeg, or WebP format as a Uint8List. It supports custom sampling filters, quality settings, and preserves image orientation.
use_when: You need image compression on Windows and Linux desktops
You want native performance for image resizing and format conversion
avoid_when: You need Web support with WASM
You want to avoid native toolchain dependencies like Rust and Android NDK
strengths: Supports desktop platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS) in addition to mobile
Provides multiple sampling filters and compression formats (Jpeg, WebP, AVIF)
weaknesses: Requires Rust and Android NDK setup
Does not support Web with WASM
data.setup_notes: Requires installing Rust, cargo tools, and Android NDK for Android targets.
